# Module reference

Every page below is generated from the sources of the `warpt` package by `docs/make_reference.py`, which reads them with `ast` and never imports them. The signatures, defaults and descriptions are therefore exactly what the code says. The entry point comes first, then the pipeline stages in the order a run executes them, then the support layers and the standalone tools.

| Module | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`warpt.orchestrator`](orchestrator.md) | Command-line entry point and run setup for WARP. |
| [`warpt.workflow_preconditioning`](workflow_preconditioning.md) | Force-constant preconditioning schedule run before the first variable-cell iteration. |
| [`warpt.workflow_vc_relax`](workflow_vc_relax.md) | Outer variable-cell relaxation loop of WARP. |
| [`warpt.tdep_sampling`](tdep_sampling.md) | Thermal sampling and calculator dispatch for one work directory. |
| [`warpt.tdep_extract_fc`](tdep_extract_fc.md) | Force-constant extraction, Wyckoff projection and the structure-physicality gate. |
| [`warpt.tdep_collect`](tdep_collect.md) | Collect calculator outputs into TDEP input files. |
| [`warpt.phonon_stress`](phonon_stress.md) | Phonon (Grüneisen) stress ``sigma_ph``, the total internal stress, and the dispersion runner. |
| [`warpt.compliance_update`](compliance_update.md) | Elastic-compliance lattice update inside the lattice step of the variable-cell relaxation. |
| [`warpt.noise_gain`](noise_gain.md) | Noise-referenced lattice damping gain and stress noise estimate. |
| [`warpt.Wyckoff_Projector`](Wyckoff_Projector.md) | Symmetry projection of TDEP first-order displacements onto Wyckoff site parameters. |
| [`warpt.context_state`](context_state.md) | Run configuration and mutable state containers. |
| [`warpt.resume`](resume.md) | Stage-granular, idempotent completion of one work directory. |
| [`warpt.restart_check`](restart_check.md) | Resume planner for an existing run tree. |
| [`warpt.runner`](runner.md) | Calculator invocation and a small parallel job pool. |
| [`warpt.MLIP_interface`](MLIP_interface.md) | Machine-learned potential backend that mimics Quantum ESPRESSO output. |
| [`warpt.VASP_interface`](VASP_interface.md) | VASP backend that mimics Quantum ESPRESSO output. |
| [`warpt.upet_relax`](upet_relax.md) | Symmetry-constrained static vc-relax onto the MLIP's own minimum at a target pressure. |
| [`warpt.structconv`](structconv.md) | Crystal-structure conversion between POSCAR and Quantum ESPRESSO input/output. |
| [`warpt.io_poscar`](io_poscar.md) | POSCAR / VASP5 structure I/O for WARP. |
| [`warpt.io_qe`](io_qe.md) | Quantum ESPRESSO input/output helpers for WARP. |
| [`warpt.io_workflow`](io_workflow.md) | Geometry and force-constant handoff between WARP stages. |
| [`warpt.tensors`](tensors.md) | Voigt <-> 3x3 tensor conversions for the stress/strain path. |
| [`warpt.constants`](constants.md) | Physical constants and unit conversions used throughout the package. |
| [`warpt.utilities`](utilities.md) | Process, shell and filesystem helpers used throughout WARP. |
| [`warpt.validity`](validity.md) | Stage-completion predicates for WARP's idempotent resume. |
| [`warpt.resources`](resources.md) | Access to packaged data files. |
| [`warpt.timing`](timing.md) | Wall-time records of external commands and workflow stages. |
| [`warpt.get_frames`](get_frames.md) | Collect a WARP run's structures, in run order, into one trajectory. |
| [`warpt.metrics`](metrics.md) | Structure-comparison metrics between two POSCAR files. |
| [`warpt.trajectory`](trajectory.md) | Reference-free, step-by-step tracking of the structure and convergence of a WARP run. |
| [`warpt.plot_phonons_iter`](plot_phonons_iter.md) | Phonon dispersions of every step of a WARP run, in execution order. |
| [`warpt.band_yaml`](band_yaml.md) | Phonopy ``band.yaml`` from the phonon dispersion of a WARP step. |
| [`warpt.static_elastic`](static_elastic.md) | Static elastic constants of a unit cell from a machine-learned potential, for ``--elastic_constants``. |
